import csv, pickle, time
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_score, StratifiedKFold
from features import BirdFeatures

t0 = time.time()
rows = list(csv.DictReader(open("data/train/labels.csv")))
X = np.stack([np.asarray(Image.open("data/train/images/" + r["name"]).convert("RGB"), dtype=np.float32).reshape(-1) / 255.0 for r in rows])
y = np.array([r["label"] for r in rows])

# augment: horizontal flip
Xf = X.reshape(-1, 64, 64, 3)[:, :, ::-1, :].reshape(len(X), -1)
Xa = np.concatenate([X, Xf]); ya = np.concatenate([y, y])

for C in [0.1, 1.0, 10.0]:
    pipe = Pipeline([("f", BirdFeatures()), ("s", StandardScaler()), ("c", LinearSVC(C=C, max_iter=5000))])
    sc = cross_val_score(pipe, X, y, cv=StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=0), n_jobs=1)
    print("LinearSVC C=", C, sc.mean(), round(time.time() - t0, 1), flush=True)

pipe = Pipeline([("f", BirdFeatures()), ("s", StandardScaler()), ("c", LinearSVC(C=1.0, max_iter=5000))])
pipe.fit(Xa, ya)
pickle.dump(pipe, open("model.pkl", "wb"))
print("train acc", pipe.score(X, y), round(time.time() - t0, 1))
